verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting transcription and summary tool, so multilingual support is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents transcription, summaries and diarized transcripts but never mentions supported languages, non-English meetings or handling language switching mid-meeting. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching
